name: SambaNova Cloud
short: SambaNova's fast inference cloud for open models, with a no-payment-method free tier and pay-per-token developer access.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: 20 RPM, 20 RPD and 200K TPD per model; applied when no payment method is linked.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: 20M tokens/day across all models; gpt-oss-120b $0.22/$0.59 and gemma-4-31B $0.38/$1.15 per 1M.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Higher rate limits and dedicated capacity via SambaNova sales.
